Hartley & Doyle — home renovations and carpentry, Narre Warren VIC 3805.

Thirty-one years on the tools between the two of us. Dan came through as a chippy in 1994 and
Marcus joined him in 2006. We have taken a house back to the frame and put it together again more
times than either of us can count, and in all that time we have never once quoted a room off a
price list.

HOW WE CHARGE
We charge for our time. Every job is different and every old house hides something, so we do not
publish a price for a bathroom or a kitchen the way the bigger outfits do. You get our hourly rate,
an honest estimate of the hours, and an invoice for the hours we actually worked. If it takes less
than we said, you pay less.

Dan on the tools $110 per hour.
Marcus on the tools $95 per hour.
The two of us together $185 per hour.
Apprentice $55 per hour.
Day rate for the pair, seven hours on site $1,240 per day.
Weekend and public holiday work $165 per hour.

Demolition and strip-out is charged at the same hourly rate. A bathroom usually runs a day and a
half between us; a kitchen closer to two days, more if the cabinetry is screwed and glued.

Plastering, painting, tiling, flooring, skirting, architraves, doors and cabinetry are all our own
work and all charged by the hour. We do not sub any of it out except the electrical, the plumbing
and the gas, which go to licensed blokes we have used for years and who invoice you directly.

Materials are at cost plus 10% if we pick them up, or you buy them yourself and we will fit them.
Either way you see the receipts.

Waste disposal is included in our hours. We take a trailer to the tip at the end of a job and the
tip fees go on the invoice at cost.

WHAT WE WILL NOT DO
We will not tell you a wall can come out until we have been in the roof and had a look. We will not
tell you whether you need a permit until we know what you are doing and where you are. Anyone who
gives you either of those answers over the phone is guessing with your house.

THE REST
All prices include GST. Based in Narre Warren, we travel 25km.
Minimum charge for a call-out is four hours. We do not charge for the first visit to look at a job.
Ten year workmanship warranty on anything structural we build.
Not included: permits, engineering, council fees, electrical, plumbing, gas, asbestos removal,
appliance supply and stone fabrication.
